import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*A + p[2]*A**2 + p[3]*t + p[4]*t**2
            + np.exp(-p[5]*t)*(p[6] + p[7]*A + p[8]*A**2 + p[9]*A**3))

def nm(cols):
    X=np.column_stack(cols)
    s=np.linalg.norm(X,axis=0); Xs=X/s
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(Xs,dA_dt,rcond=None); c=c/s
    r=dA_dt-X@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dA_dt), c
